# Python 3.15 source and native dependency provenance

This source checkout uses `uv sync --frozen --all-groups --all-extras` and explicit relative `tool.uv.sources`. The complete Polygon 1.15.4 source distribution is retained under `polygon-api-client`; only `polygon/modelclass.py` changes private namespace annotation access to normal `cls.__annotations__` access. Its original MIT license is retained. The official archive SHA and changed boundary are in `liu315-polygon-source-provenance.json`; all 93 genuine dataclass field shapes/order match the unpatched release on Python 3.13.

On macOS arm64, pygit2 1.20.1 resolves to the checked native wheel in `native-wheels`. It was source-built for CPython 3.15 and a genuine macOS 11 deployment target from exact official pygit2/libgit2/libssh2/OpenSSL sources, then delocated. All linked non-system libraries and their original licenses are included. SHA-256: `b08df6cdef0ad22416af4b4934d2e97e37b9850e9bf0b5f34dba72244b075271`. Runtime dynamic links/rpaths need no original build prefix; actual feature mask1791 matches the prior official Python 3.13 wheel. This records a deployment target, not execution testing on an unavailable macOS 11 machine. Other platforms fall back to the unchanged upstream dependency and need their own genuine build/runtime proof.

`native-wheels/rebuild_native.py` is executable with managed CPython 3.15 and the four immutable source archives included in `native-sources`. Its defaults work from a fresh source checkout and create the build tree in the system temporary directory:

```sh
uv run --no-sync python vendor/native-wheels/rebuild_native.py
```

Optional `--archive-root` and `--work-parent` arguments select alternative retained archives and an owned build parent. The checked-in archives retain their original embedded license files and exact bytes; `native-sources/archives.json` records their sizes and hashes. Its four input filenames and exact SHA-256 values are embedded in the script and match the source-provenance records. Retained official inputs are `liu315-openssl-official-source.tar.gz`, `liu315-libssh2-official-source.tar.gz`, `liu315-libgit2-official-source.tar.gz`, and `liu315-pygit2-original.tar.gz`. It creates a fresh uniquely named owned tree, builds every native library from source with one job, bundles libraries/licenses, updates RECORD, checks targets and dynamic linkage, and installs into a new isolated control venv. All build prefixes are temporarily hidden for its import/feature check. It also verifies every original archive entry remains unchanged after building. A separate actual execution of this workflow succeeded, recorded in `liu315-native-rebuild-8pyyo27u/result.json`; it does not claim byte-identical wheels across timestamps/toolchains/build paths.

The source distribution includes this vendor directory. The project wheel metadata cannot carry uv source routing: plain pip installation of the project wheel alone does not select these patched/native dependencies. Use the documented source-checkout/frozen-uv route; do not describe standalone pip wheel installation as verified Python 3.15 support. Original-source URLs/commits and licenses are recorded alongside the artifact rather than assuming an untracked host library.
